# Feature: Twin Jolly — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #92 (Twin Jolly) from Movement Tiles before it is used in real levels. Effect: one input moves both at once. Unique: two players on screen under one set of inputs. Useful: synchronised puzzles no single Jolly can solve. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** one input moves both at once.

**So that** synchronised puzzles no single Jolly can solve.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Twin Jolly for the first time in its teaching room (mech-92-twin-jolly-room). Teaching moment: First room: two Jollys in connected lanes, one lane passing a hazard. A player who makes the obvious move for the Jolly they are watching moves the other one into the hazard with the same input and loses the level, which teaches that every input is checked against both positions. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: A level mode, not a tile: two Jollys share one input
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Each step both try to move
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: A blocked one stays
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Orbs and keys are shared, and if either Jolly touches a lethal enemy or hazard the level is lost

## Edge Cases & Rules

- A blocked one stays
- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Twin Jolly's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-92-twin-jolly-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/movement-tiles.yml mechanic #92.
